---
title: "Mental Performance"
---

```{r setup-root, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r setup}
source("Global.R")
source("plot_functions.R")
source("Themes.R")

csi_red  <- "#D71920"
csi_grey <- "#A7A9AC"
```

```{r rsi-data}
rsi_wide <- read_xlsx("sample_data/outcome_data.xlsx", sheet = "acl_rsi") |>
  mutate(
    date       = as.Date(Date),
    mean_score = round(rowMeans(across(q1:q12)))
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

rsi_item_labels <- c(
  "Q1 – Confident in previous performance",
  "Q2 – Likely to re-injure",
  "Q3 – Nervous about playing sport",
  "Q4 – Knee won't give way",
  "Q5 – Play sport without concern",
  "Q6 – Frustrated by knee consideration",
  "Q7 – Fearful of re-injury",
  "Q8 – Knee holds under pressure",
  "Q9 – Afraid of accidental injury",
  "Q10 – Surgery/rehab thoughts intrude",
  "Q11 – Confident in performance ability",
  "Q12 – Relaxed about playing sport"
)

rsi_long <- rsi_wide |>
  pivot_longer(q1:q12, names_to = "item", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(
    item_label = factor(
      recode(item,
        q1  = rsi_item_labels[1],  q2  = rsi_item_labels[2],
        q3  = rsi_item_labels[3],  q4  = rsi_item_labels[4],
        q5  = rsi_item_labels[5],  q6  = rsi_item_labels[6],
        q7  = rsi_item_labels[7],  q8  = rsi_item_labels[8],
        q9  = rsi_item_labels[9],  q10 = rsi_item_labels[10],
        q11 = rsi_item_labels[11], q12 = rsi_item_labels[12]
      ),
      levels = rsi_item_labels
    )
  )

rsi_cutoff <- 56
```

```{r rsi-plots}
rsi_line <- ggplot(rsi_wide, aes(x = date, y = mean_score)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = rsi_cutoff, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#447099", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = max(rsi_wide$date), y = rsi_cutoff + 3,
           label = "RTS readiness threshold (≥56)", hjust = 1,
           size = 3, colour = "#447099", fontface = "italic") +
  geom_line(colour = csi_grey, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = mean_score, text = paste0("Date: ", date, "<br>Mean Score: ", mean_score)),
             shape = 21, size = 4, colour = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = csi_red, high = "#2E7D32",
                      limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d '%y",
               breaks = rsi_wide$date,
               expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Score (0–100)") +
  ak_plot_theme()

rsi_heat <- rsi_long |>
  mutate(item_label = fct_rev(item_label)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = item_label, fill = score,
             text = paste0(item_label, "<br>Date: ", date, "<br>Score: ", score))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = csi_red, high = "#2E7D32",
                      limits = c(0, 100),
                      breaks = c(0, 50, 100),
                      labels = c("0", "50", "100"),
                      name = "Score") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d '%y",
               breaks = rsi_wide$date,
               expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ak_plot_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank())
```

```{r rsi-card}
htmltools::div(
  class = "phase0-navset",
  navset_card_tab(
    full_screen = TRUE,
    title = htmltools::tags$span(style = "font-weight:700; font-size:1.2rem;", "ACL-RSI"),
    nav_panel(
      "Total Score",
      ggplotly(rsi_line, tooltip = "text")
    ),
    nav_panel(
      "Item Heatmap",
      ggplotly(rsi_heat, tooltip = "text")
    )
  )
)
```

```{r tsk-data}
tsk_wide <- read_xlsx("sample_data/outcome_data.xlsx", sheet = "tsk_11") |>
  mutate(
    date  = as.Date(Date),
    total = rowSums(across(q1:q11))
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

tsk_item_labels <- c(
  "Q1 – Afraid of injury when exercising",
  "Q2 – Pain would increase if I try",
  "Q3 – Something dangerously wrong",
  "Q4 – Pain relieved by exercise",
  "Q5 – Not taken seriously enough",
  "Q6 – Body at risk for life",
  "Q7 – Pain = injury",
  "Q8 – Must avoid unnecessary movements",
  "Q9 – Pain implies danger",
  "Q10 – Can't do normal things",
  "Q11 – Shouldn't exercise when in pain"
)

tsk_long <- tsk_wide |>
  pivot_longer(q1:q11, names_to = "item", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(
    item_label = factor(
      recode(item,
        q1  = tsk_item_labels[1],  q2  = tsk_item_labels[2],
        q3  = tsk_item_labels[3],  q4  = tsk_item_labels[4],
        q5  = tsk_item_labels[5],  q6  = tsk_item_labels[6],
        q7  = tsk_item_labels[7],  q8  = tsk_item_labels[8],
        q9  = tsk_item_labels[9],  q10 = tsk_item_labels[10],
        q11 = tsk_item_labels[11]
      ),
      levels = tsk_item_labels
    )
  )
```

```{r tsk-plots}
cutoff <- 28

tsk_line <- ggplot(tsk_wide, aes(x = date, y = total)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = csi_red, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = max(tsk_wide$date), y = cutoff + 0.8,
           label = "Elevated threshold (≥28)", hjust = 1,
           size = 3, colour = csi_red, fontface = "italic") +
  geom_line(colour = csi_grey, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = total, text = paste0("Date: ", date, "<br>Total: ", total)),
             shape = 21, size = 4, colour = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#2E7D32", high = csi_red,
                      limits = c(11, 44), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d '%y",
               breaks = tsk_wide$date,
               expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(10, 45), breaks = seq(10, 44, by = 5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Score (11–44)") +
  ak_plot_theme()

tsk_heat <- tsk_long |>
  mutate(item_label = fct_rev(item_label)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = item_label, fill = score,
             text = paste0(item_label, "<br>Date: ", date, "<br>Score: ", score))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#2E7D32", high = csi_red,
                      limits = c(1, 4), breaks = 1:4,
                      labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"),
                      name = "Score") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d '%y",
               breaks = tsk_wide$date,
               expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ak_plot_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank())
```
